en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 9. Ḥusain ibn Aḥmad ibn Mughīrah (the student of the author) added the following: Aḥmad ibn Idrīs ibn Aḥmad ibn Zakariyyā Al-Qummi narrated from Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdil Jabbār, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā’īl, from Muḥammad ibn ‘Amr, from Qā`id Al-Ḥannāť, who said:
I asked Abal Ḥasan Al-Māďi (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) about establishing prayers in the two Ḥarams. Imam (a.s.) replied, “Establish prayers in full form even if you are passing through (Makkah or Madīnah).”
